title: docs(permissions): a three-officer split keeps the auditor's set outside the organization boundary
body:
Refs #34700 (item 2)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:在委派管理文档里写明「三员分立」规则——审计员的权限集须带一个平台级能力,使其落在组织边界之外;并在 plugin-security 加 12 条真实引擎钉子测试。无源码改动。
- 为什么改:按维护者裁决 E,只写文档、不改契约;同时补一次裁决所欠的实测:委派管理员的白名单路径对这类权限集照旧放行或拒绝。
- 风险与回滚:只有文档与测试,运行时零变化;回滚即撤销本 PR。测试文件仍在原 20 秒预算内(按共享机比例推算 19.0 秒)。
- 先看:`content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx` 新增的「Separation of duties: the three-officer split」一节;其次是 `org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts` 末尾新的 describe 及其期望矩阵 `OFFICER_EXPECTED`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts -t three-officer`,预期 12 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Docs** (`content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx`): a new section, *Separation of duties: the three-officer split*, and one row in the gate table for the organization administrator's own right. The rule it teaches: in a three-officer split the auditor's set carries a platform-scoped capability, which keeps it outside the organization boundary, so only a delegated scope whose allowlist names the set, or the platform administrator, adds or removes its holders. It lists the four boundary conditions (ADR-0090 D12, as amended), shows an app-declared capability (whose `scope` defaults to `platform`) and the built-in `setup.access` as the two ways to carry one, and states the ceiling: the platform administrator can still assign any set, the auditor's included.
- **Tests** (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts`): a new top-level describe in the existing posture harness (real ObjectQL engine over a real SQL driver, real `SecurityPlugin`, the protocol's bulk delete door), postures `single` and `isolated`. Three auditor variants (org-scoped only, plus `setup.access`, plus an app-declared capability) against six callers, four write shapes each (a direct grant, its removal by id, its removal through the bulk delete door, a position holding added and removed). No source file changes.

## Tests

The expected matrix, every cell asserted on its ADR-0112 envelope and on the stored rows:

| Caller | + `setup.access` | + app-declared capability |
|---|---|---|
| organization administrator (both sets) | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, naming the set | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, naming the set |
| delegate whose allowlist leaves the auditor set out | `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION` | same |
| the same delegate, also an organization administrator | `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION` | same |
| delegate whose allowlist names the auditor set, with or without the organization administrator's set | admitted | admitted |

The control variant, an auditor set carrying only the org-scoped `view_all_audit_log`, sits inside the boundary and is judged by the organization administrator's right as ADR-0090 D12 (as amended) states it, and by the allowlist on the delegated path; it proves each refusal above is caused by the platform-scoped capability.

The last two rows are the owed measurement: the delegated allowlist path admits and refuses a set carrying a platform-scoped capability exactly as it does the org-scoped one.

## Acceptance notes

- Two existing docs lines predate the ADR-0090 D12 amendment and still say the organization administrator's set is read-only on the RBAC tables: `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx` (the anti-escalation paragraph) and the `organization_admin` row of the built-in sets table in `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`. The shipped set grants create and delete on both assignment tables. Not changed here; noted for the docs lane.
- No changeset: the diff is a docs page and a test file; `plugin-security` publishes `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` only, so nothing a package ships changes (`skip-changeset`).
